title: Save (ex-Solend) — config-rot tail holds no live unprivileged extraction

one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live (dust only, ~$96) from the Save/ex-Solend config-rot tail: 449/603 reserves are frozen by dead oracles (all Switchboard + legacy Pyth feeds offline), the 154 live reserves are correctly priced except one junk-market Fartcoin reserve that is fenced by zero limits, and no material obligation is currently liquidatable (whitelisted-market bad debt ~$3.27M is frozen even for the keeper); latent risk is $3.84M of main-pool debt within 10% of liquidation ($107.7k within 5%) where stale LST price scales would pay first-mover liquidators 5-18% spreads.
